sections.body: The trace of where information came from and how it reached this record.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: A quotation needs a book, edition and page—not just the author’s name.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: An answer points to a chunk, its document version, the document and the original source.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: The Source → Document → DocumentVersion → Chunk → Assertion lineage is preserved.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Without lineage, a changed or deleted original makes old answers difficult to explain.
